name: Dr Rohini Kasturi
specialization: Endocrinology, Diabetes & Metabolism (Endocrinologist / Diabetologist) - Type 1, Type 2 and gestational diabetes; thyroid disorders and thyroid cancer; parathyroid; pituitary and adrenal disorders; obesity and metabolic conditions; PCOS and women's endocrine health; osteoporosis. verified_role: Sr. Consultant - Endocrinology, Star Hospitals, Nanakramguda / Financial District, Hyderabad (also consulting at the Star Hospitals Banjara Hills campus). Formerly Assistant Chief Resident, New York Downtown Hospital, New York, NY (2008-2009), and in independent endocrinology practice in Cookeville, Tennessee, USA.
verified_experience: Published figures vary by source and are recorded verbatim rather than reconciled: 'Sr. Consultant in Endocrinology with 20 years of experience' (Star Hospitals official profile); 'over 15 years' (Apollo Hospitals); '22 years' (US listings); '11 years' (some Indian aggregator listings, likely counting only her India-side practice). Career timeline is consistent with an MD in 2003 and continuous practice since, i.e. roughly 20+ years.
hni_signals: STRONG internationally-credentialled returnee profile. Published seniority title: 'Sr. Consultant - Endocrinology' at Star Hospitals. Multi-site and multi-group practice: named profiles at Star Hospitals Nanakramguda/Financial District AND Star Hospitals Banjara Hills, plus a separate listing at Apollo Hospitals Financial District - three published practice locations across two hospital groups. Foreign board-level credential: 'MD, FACE' - FACE is Fellow of the American College of Endocrinology, awarded by AACE only after certification, training and professional clinical endocrinology experience, and she carries a live AACE 'Find an Endocrinologist' professional listing. US training and practice: MD from Osmania Medical College (2003); Internal Medicine residency at New York Downtown Hospital, New York, where she rose to Assistant Chief Resident (2008-2009); Fellowship in Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolism at State University of New York (SUNY) Upstate, Syracuse; then independent endocrinology practice in Cookeville, Tennessee. International society memberships published on the Star Hospitals profile: The Endocrine Society, USA (2011-present), American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists (2010-present), American Medical Association (2014-2015), Tennessee Medical Association (2011-present), plus Indian Medical Association (2023-present) and Endocrine Society of India (2023-present) - the 2023 start dates on the Indian bodies date her return to India. Media/thought-leadership: authors public health content under her own name for Star Hospitals, e.g. the news-media piece 'Diabetes: A Call to Action'. Advanced procedural skill set (thyroid ultrasound, bone densitometry interpretation, telecytopathology assessment of thyroid FNAs). No published procedure volume figure was found, so none is recorded. No evidence of an independently owned clinic in India - she practises within the Star and Apollo groups - so owns_clinic is false, though note she did run a US practice previously.

notes: HIGH band earned by TWO genuinely independent official hospital sources that agree on name + specialty + city + micro-location: (1) apollohospitals.com endocrinologist page, which states she practises at Apollo Hospitals, FINANCIAL DISTRICT, Hyderabad - matching the input row exactly on hospital, specialty and location; (2) starhospitals.in, a different hospital group, with three separate official pages (Nanakramguda/Financial District profile, Banjara Hills profile, and a named booking page). Skedoc, HexaHealth, MediFyr and Bajaj Finserv are corroborating-only and were not counted. IDENTITY CROSS-CHECK ON THE US RECORDS - done deliberately because a US endocrinologist of the same name in Cookeville, Tennessee surfaced and could have been a different person. She is the SAME person, and the proof is internal to the Indian official source: the Star Hospitals profile itself publishes 'Assistant Chief Resident at New York Downtown Hospital, New York, NY (2008-2009)' and membership of the 'Tennessee Medical Association (2011-Present)' and 'American Medical Association (2014-2015)' - and the US listings independently give her residency as New York Downtown Hospital and her practice as Cookeville, TN. The Star profile also shows her Indian society memberships (IMA, Endocrine Society of India) beginning only in 2023, which dates her return to India. Two independent chains of evidence converge, so the AACE society listing and the US practice-history entries are recorded as hers with confidence. Note the AACE URL contains 'Cookeville' because that was her US practice city - it is genuinely her listing, not a name collision.
